intro: 12 個電腦與網路情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

words.zh: 進入或使用的權利;獲得、進入

ex.en: You can't gain access to the files unless you know the password.
ex.zh: 除非你知道密碼,否則無法存取這些檔案。

ex.en: We accessed the information on the company's website.
ex.zh: 我們在公司網站上取得了這項資訊。

note: gain / have / deny access to sth
accessible 可存取的、易取得的;accessibility 無障礙性

ex.en: The office manager did not allocate enough money to purchase software.
ex.zh: 辦公室主管沒有分配足夠的經費來購買軟體。

ex.en: We will need to allocate more space on the website for advertising.
ex.zh: 我們需要在網站上分配更多空間放廣告。

note: allocate sth to sb / allocate sb sth

ex.en: This operating system is not compatible with this model computer.
ex.zh: 這個作業系統與這型號的電腦不相容。

ex.en: Users of software applications want new versions to be compatible with current versions.
ex.zh: 軟體應用程式的使用者希望新版本能與目前的版本相容。

note: be compatible with sth,介系詞固定用 with

ex.en: The technicians deleted all the data on the disk accidentally.
ex.zh: 技術人員不小心刪掉了磁碟上的所有資料。

ex.en: This button on the keyboard deletes the characters from the screen.
ex.zh: 鍵盤上的這個按鍵會把螢幕上的字元刪除。

ex.en: The light on the LCD display is too weak.
ex.zh: 這個 LCD 顯示器的亮度太弱了。

ex.en: The webpage does not display secure information such as passwords and credit card numbers.
ex.zh: 這個網頁不會顯示密碼和信用卡號等機密資訊。

note: 名詞動詞同形;on display 展示中

ex.en: I think the new word processing program will duplicate the success of the one introduced last year.
ex.zh: 我認為這個新的文書處理程式會複製去年推出那款的成功。

ex.en: Duplicate the file and save it in another place.
ex.zh: 複製這個檔案並存到另一個地方。

note: 動詞唸 /-keɪt/,形容詞與名詞唸 /-kət/
duplication 複製;duplicate copy 副本

ex.en: Your failure to inform us about the changed password cost the company a day's work.
ex.zh: 你沒有通知我們密碼已更改,讓公司損失了一天的工作。

ex.en: The repeated failure of her printer baffled the technician.
ex.zh: 她的印表機反覆故障,讓技術人員困惑不已。

note: failure to + 原形動詞,表示「未能做到⋯」

ex.en: By examining all of the errors, the technicians figured out how to fix the problem.
ex.zh: 透過檢視所有錯誤,技術人員找出了修復問題的方法。

ex.en: We figured out that it would take us at least ten minutes to download the file.
ex.zh: 我們算出下載這個檔案至少要花十分鐘。

note: 可分離片語:figure it out,代名詞須放中間

ex.en: When the director is working at the computer, she ignores everything around her.
ex.zh: 主管在電腦前工作時,會忽略周遭的一切。

ex.en: Don't ignore the technician's advice when connecting cables.
ex.zh: 接線時別忽視技術人員的建議。

note: ignore 是刻意忽視;be ignorant of 是不知情

ex.en: Our search of the database produced very little information.
ex.zh: 我們對資料庫的搜尋只找到很少的資訊。

ex.en: If you search the Internet, I'm sure you'll find all the information you need.
ex.zh: 如果你上網搜尋,相信你會找到所有需要的資訊。

note: search for sth 尋找某物;search sth 搜查某處

ex.en: Please shut down the computer before you leave.
ex.zh: 離開前請把電腦關機。

ex.en: We decided to shut down the blog after receiving so many bad comments.
ex.zh: 收到這麼多負評後,我們決定關閉這個部落格。

note: 可分離:shut it down;名詞形 shutdown 寫在一起

ex.en: The red flashing light gives a warning to users that the battery is low.
ex.zh: 紅色閃燈警告使用者電量不足。

ex.en: Flashing images on a webpage are warnings to attract users' attention.
ex.zh: 網頁上閃動的影像是用來吸引使用者注意的警示。

note: give / issue a warning;without warning 毫無預警
warn 警告;warn sb about / of sth
